_from: docs/plans/stories/PLAN.md. Story paintings for lord: one 1536x864 scene a page, filed as art/story/<story id>-<page>.webp. Matches docs/lord-art style b.

styles.a: Dark gritty painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, rich muted earthy colours with warm firelight glow, dramatic cinematic light, a storybook illustration, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no blood, no gore, no romance, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

pictures.name: lord-opening-1
pictures.prompt: A happy medieval village at night, a hundred warm paper lanterns glowing along the cobbled streets, a bakery with warm light and steam, villagers chatting. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-2
pictures.prompt: A great red dragon swooping over village rooftops at night, carrying sacks of treasure, baskets of bread and strings of lanterns in its claws, villagers hiding. Not scary-gory. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-3
pictures.prompt: The same village in grey dim morning, no lanterns, an empty market with bare stalls, a quiet inn with shutters closed, sad but safe. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-4
pictures.prompt: A very old kind grey-haired village woman holding a big rusty key, opening the heavy wooden door of a dusty stone training hall with weapon racks and old banners inside, light spilling out. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-5
pictures.prompt: A young hero of about ten holding a wooden sword high in the village square, determined and brave, villagers watching hopefully, seen from slightly behind. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-6
pictures.prompt: A winding dirt road leading from a little village through a dark forest towards distant volcanic mountains with a glowing red cave mouth, a small hero walking the road. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-pip-1
pictures.prompt: Inside a dusty stone training hall with weapon racks and old banners, a small, very serious little sword-master (a short grown-up person with a stern face) holding a huge wooden staff three times taller than themselves, a young hero of about ten facing them with a wooden sword, seen from behind. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-wren-1
pictures.prompt: A sharp-eyed woman knight in worn steel armour sitting by a warm fireplace sharpening a sword on a whetstone, raising one eyebrow at a young hero of about ten with muddy boots standing in the doorway of a stone hall. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-tumble-1
pictures.prompt: A clumsy cheerful knight with a dented helmet tripping over a wooden bucket in a sunny castle training yard, arms flailing, sword still held perfectly steady, a young hero of about ten watching, trying not to laugh. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-marrow-1
pictures.prompt: A very old wiry fighter with a long white beard, bald head and a wooden staff, sitting calmly on a bench sipping a cup of tea under a huge ancient gnarled tree, smiling kindly at a young hero of about ten. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-quill-1
pictures.prompt: An elegant woman fencer with a thin rapier, feathered hat and fine coat, unrolling an enormously long scroll of rules that spills across the floor of a grand hall, a young hero of about ten staring at the scroll. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-basalt-1
pictures.prompt: A huge broad man with stone-grey skin and hands as big as boulders striding into a rocky quarry training ground, small pebbles bouncing off the ground as he walks, a young hero of about ten looking up at him. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-thistle-1
pictures.prompt: A sweet-smiling woman knight in thistle-purple armour in a garden of tall purple thistles, holding out a teacup in one hand and a gleaming very sharp sword in the other, a young hero of about ten opposite her. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-brisk-1
pictures.prompt: A crisp upright army captain with a neat moustache, smart blue coat and a sabre, checking a brass pocket watch on a chain beside a castle clock tower at dawn, a young hero of about ten standing to attention. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-ember-1
pictures.prompt: An old wizard-warrior with a grey beard and a tall pointed hat with a small friendly flame burning on top of it, warming his hands at the flame on a cosy evening hilltop, a young hero of about ten listening. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-stonefist-1
pictures.prompt: A giant gatekeeper in heavy stone-coloured armour with huge gauntlets standing in front of a massive stone gate across a mountain road, arms folded, blocking the way, a young hero of about ten in front of him. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-master-orrin-1
pictures.prompt: A calm powerful grand master in white and gold robes with a softly glowing sword, standing under an old pine tree on a high mountain path at sunset, a smoking dark mountain far behind, a young hero of about ten facing him. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-lair-1
pictures.prompt: A huge black volcanic mountain at dusk with smoke curling from its peak and a great cave mouth, warm lantern light glowing from deep inside the cave, a small young hero standing at the bottom of the path looking up. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-lair-2
pictures.prompt: Inside a vast cave, a huge red dragon with spiky dark-red scales, pale belly, curling horns and glowing yellow eyes uncurling from a pile of gold coins, treasure and stolen glowing lanterns, smoke from its nostrils, looking down at a small young hero with a sword. Impressive, not gory. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-victory-1
pictures.prompt: A huge red dragon with spiky dark-red scales and curling horns flying away over the mountains at dawn, grumpy and sulky, a puff of smoke behind it, a young hero of about ten standing safe and proud on a rocky ledge below, unhurt. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-victory-2
pictures.prompt: A young hero of about ten pulling a wooden cart piled with treasure chests, bread baskets and strings of unlit lanterns along a sunny forest road towards a little village, smiling. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-victory-3
pictures.prompt: Dusk in a medieval village, a kind old grey-haired woman in green robes lighting the first paper lantern with a taper, more lanterns starting to glow one by one along the cobbled street, villagers coming out of their doors. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-victory-4
pictures.prompt: A joyful crowd of villagers in a lantern-lit village square at night cheering and throwing flowers, lifting a young hero of about ten up on their shoulders, a baker handing out warm loaves of bread. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-victory-5
pictures.prompt: A kind old grey-haired woman in green robes pinning a shining gold star badge onto the cloak of a proud young hero of about ten in a lantern-lit village square, friendly villagers smiling behind. Landscape, wide.
